comparison.objective: Drop-test a carton flat from 100 mm onto a pad; candidate iteratively tunes an industrial damper using controlled carriage impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Orienting, lifting, and releasing a carton versus unlocking, finely rotating, relocking, actuating a guarded control, and interpreting impact response.
comparison.success_condition: Record gives the 100 mm flat-drop condition but no damage/scoring rubric; candidate requires two in-envelope stops without bottoming, hard-stop strike, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve impact observation, but one tests executing a prescribed package drop while the other tests physical adjustment and retained dynamic energy absorption.
